name: Revenant
languages: the one it knew in life

traits.name: Relentless Pursuer
traits.text: Knows direction/distance to its target; ignores difficult terrain and exhaustion from travel.

traits.name: Vengeful Rejuvenation (1/Day)
traits.text: If reduced to 0 HP and target alive, returns to life 24 hrs later at full HP within 5 ft of target.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.text: +7 to hit. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing or 9 (1d10 + 4) two-handed.
